plan.note: An estimate from one timed training step per network. Scores are not predicted: only the classical score is measured.
plan.status.input: skipped: the card takes {card}, this data is {data}
plan.status.level_a: skipped: level A card (the authors' class); build it with dlnet paper build
plan.title: Estimate
plan.warn.few_candidates: The budget trains only {n} candidate(s) in rung 1 (Top-{topk} needs {need}): raise the budget.
plan.warn.papers_skipped: {n} of {total} paper card(s) will be skipped or fail (see the table).
plan.warn.untimed: No candidate could be timed: the run would fail on this data.
run.beats: The top-1 beats the best classical baseline on validation and test.
run.no_command: Started outside this workspace's job list (e.g. in a terminal): the command is in the terminal history.
run.not_beats: The top-1 does not clearly beat the best classical baseline: see leaderboard.md.
run.papers_note: Papers are trained with the protocol of the top-1 (same splits, {n} runs, epochs, lr). Δ = test of the paper minus test of the top-1, paired run by run; p = paired t-test, Holm-corrected over all papers. With few runs a large p means the difference is not shown, not that the networks are equal.
runs.empty: No run yet. Add data in Files, then start a new run.
runs.lead: {n} run(s) in runs/. Runs started in a terminal show up here too.
runs.title: Runs
